name: metrics_pack
description: Metrics of one pack tile instance, one row per sweep

sample_id.description: Identifier shared by every row of one sweep

sample_slot.description: Slot that triggered the sweep, 0 for periodic sweeps

sample_snapct_state.description: Snapshot load state entered, for snapct_state sweeps; unknown otherwise

sample_caught_up.description: Whether replay had caught up to the cluster tip when the sweep was taken (replay IsCaughtUp); set once per run, never cleared

sample_tile_cnt.description: Tile instances in the sweep, to detect partial sweeps

kind_id.description: Index of this tile instance among tiles of its kind

tid.description: Thread ID of the tile. Same as Pid in production, but might differ in development

last_cpu_index.description: CPU the tile last ran on

context_switch_involuntary.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Involuntary context switches

context_switch_voluntary.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Voluntary context switches

page_fault_major.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Major page faults

page_fault_minor.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Minor page faults

heartbeat_time.description: Last wall-clock time the tile heartbeated

is_backpressured.description: Whether the tile is currently backpressured

backpressure.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Times the tile waited for one or more consumers to catch up to resume publishing

regime_duration_nanos.description: Tile wall time, by regime; regimes are exhaustive and groups Busy, Idle, Backpressure and Housekeeping partition it

thread_duration_nanos.description: Thread wall time since start, by scheduler state; Idle is the remainder, so parts sum to about the lifetime.  User, System and Interrupt have 10 ms resolution; Interrupt is 0 unless it is the only live tile pinned to its CPU

wait.description: Wait (task was runnable but not scheduled)

user.description: User (task was scheduled and executing in user mode)

system.description: System (task was scheduled and executing in kernel mode)

interrupt.description: Interrupt (CPU time stolen by hardirq/softirq handlers or a hypervisor; fixed tiles only)

park_attempted.description: Times the tile tried to park while idle (efficient mode), by result

pending.description: Pre-park recheck found work, did not park

device_irq.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Device IRQs on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 unless it is the only live tile pinned there

tlb_shootdown.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. TLB shootdowns on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 unless it is the only live tile pinned there

timer_irq.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Local timer interrupts (LOC) on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 unless it is the only live tile pinned there

microblock_schedule_empty_duration_nanos.description: Duration of discovering that no transaction is schedulable

txn_insert_duration_nanos.description: Duration of inserting one transaction into the pending pool

microblock_complete_duration_nanos.description: Duration of marking one microblock as complete

txn_per_microblock.description: Transactions in a scheduled microblock, including both votes and non-votes

vote_per_microblock.description: Simple vote transactions in a scheduled microblock

txn_rx.description: Transactions received from resolv, including bundle members

txn_insert_attempted.description: Insert attempts, by result; bundle members are counted individually with the bundle's result

instr_too_many_accounts.description: Transaction has an instruction that references too many accounts

nonce_conflict.description: Bundle with two conflicting durable nonce transactions

account_blocklisted.description: Transaction uses an account on the account blocklist

bundle_blocklisted.description: Transaction is a vote in a bundle or uses an account on the bundle blocklist

invalid_nonce.description: Transaction is an invalid durable nonce transaction

write_sysvar.description: Transaction tries to write to a sysvar

estimation_failed.description: Estimating compute cost or fee failed

duplicate_account.description: Transaction included an account address twice

too_many_accounts.description: Transaction tried to load too many accounts

lut_unsupported.description: Transaction loads accounts from a lookup table, which is not supported here

unaffordable.description: Fee payer's balance below transaction fee

duplicate.description: Pack aware of transaction with same signature

nonce_priority_too_low.description: Transaction's fee was too low given its compute unit requirement and another competing transactions that uses the same durable nonce

priority_too_low.description: Transaction's fee was too low given its compute unit requirement and other competing transactions

nonvote_add.description: Transaction that was not a simple vote added to pending transactions

vote_add.description: Simple vote transaction was added to pending transactions

nonvote_replace.description: Transaction that was not a simple vote replaced a lower priority transaction

vote_replace.description: Simple vote transaction replaced a lower priority transaction

nonce_nonvote_add.description: Durable nonce transaction added to pending transactions

unused.description: Never produced: durable nonce transactions can't be simple votes

nonce_nonvote_replace.description: Durable nonce transaction replaced a lower priority transaction, likely one that uses the same durable nonce

schedule_regime_duration_nanos.description: Time pack spent, by scheduling regime

none.description: No microblock: not leader, no transactions, no available execle

txn.description: No microblock: not leader, transactions available, no available execle

execle.description: No microblock: not leader, no transactions, execle available

txn_execle.description: No microblock: not leader, transactions available, execle available

leader.description: No microblock: leader, no transactions, no available execle

txn_leader.description: No microblock: leader, transactions available, no available execle

execle_leader.description: No microblock: leader, no transactions, execle available

txn_execle_leader.description: No microblock: leader, transactions available, execle available (all conflicting)

microblock.description: Scheduled a microblock: not leader, no transactions, no available execle

txn_microblock.description: Scheduled a microblock: not leader, transactions available, no available execle

execle_microblock.description: Scheduled a microblock: not leader, no transactions, execle available

txn_execle_microblock.description: Scheduled a microblock: not leader, transactions available, execle available

leader_microblock.description: Scheduled a microblock: leader, no transactions, no available execle

txn_leader_microblock.description: Scheduled a microblock: leader, transactions available, no available execle

execle_leader_microblock.description: Scheduled a microblock: leader, no transactions, execle available

txn_execle_leader_microblock.description: Scheduled a microblock: leader, transactions available, execle available

txn_dropped.description: Transactions dropped from pack after insertion, by reason

already_executed.description: Already executed in the replay or leader pipeline

txn_evicted.description: Transactions evicted from pack to make room for others, including the bundle initializer transaction removed when a leader slot ends

txn_pending_used.description: Pending transactions in pack's pool, by type

regular.description: Transactions in the main treap, including simple votes

vote.description: Deprecated: simple votes are no longer kept in a separate treap, so this is always 0

conflicting.description: Transactions that write to a hotly-contended account, including simple votes

bundle.description: Transactions that are part of a bundle

next_auction.description: Transactions that are currently held waiting for the next auction

txn_pending_capacity.description: Maximum pending transactions pack can hold

txn_pending_smallest_cost.description: Lower bound on the cost of the cheapest pending transaction, 0 if none pending

block_microblock_limit_reached.description: Times pack did not schedule a microblock because the block microblock limit was reached

block_byte_limit_reached.description: Times pack did not schedule a microblock because the block byte limit was reached

txn_schedule_attempted.description: Times a pending transaction was considered for a microblock, by outcome; one transaction may be considered many times

taken.description: Pack included the transaction in the microblock

cu_limit.description: Pack skipped the transaction because it would have exceeded the block CU limit

conflict_fast.description: Pack skipped the transaction because of an account conflict found by the fast bitvector check

byte_limit.description: Pack skipped the transaction because it would have exceeded the block data size limit

alloc_limit.description: Pack skipped the transaction because it would have exceeded the data allocation limit

write_cost.description: Pack skipped the transaction because it would have caused a writable account to exceed the per-account block write cost limit

conflict_slow.description: Pack skipped the transaction because of an account conflict found by the full check

write_cost_deferred.description: Pack skipped the transaction because it exceeded the per-account block write cost limit too many times before

bundle_crank_attempted.description: Times pack checked whether the bundle tip state needed cranking, by outcome

up_to_date.description: On-chain state was already up to date

inserted.description: Inserted an initializer bundle to update the on-chain state

creation_failed.description: Tried to insert an initializer bundle to update the on-chain state, but creation failed

insertion_failed.description: Tried to insert an initializer bundle to update the on-chain state, but insertion failed

block_cost.description: Cost units used in the current block, 0 if not packing a block

cost_scheduled_per_block.description: Cost units scheduled for each block pack produced; can exceed the block limit because of rebates

cu_rebated_per_block.description: Compute units rebated for each block pack produced. Compute units are rebated when a transaction fails prior to execution or requests more compute units than it uses

cost_net_per_block.description: Net cost units (scheduled minus rebated) in each block pack produced

cost_per_block_pct.description: Percent of max_cost_per_block used by each block pack produced

auction_cancelled.description: Batch auctions skipped because the block was already at their CU limit

limit.description: An auction ended because the block reached the auction's CU limit

restarted.description: An auction ended because a new auction was started

final.description: An auction ended because the final 20ms of our leader rotation began

slot_end.description: An auction ended because the leader slot ended

auction_duration_nanos.description: Duration that batch auctions ran for
